links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy and differential/workup/treatment quality of ChatGPT on hand pathology vignettes
links.effect: Diagnostic accuracy 7 of 9 (78%); less reliable with complex or uncommon pathologies. Workup rated 4.1 ± 1.0, treatment plan 4.3 ± 0.8.
links.quote: The diagnostic accuracy of ChatGPT was 7 out of 9 cases, indicating an overall accuracy rate of 78%.

links.outcome: Model response to an intentionally incorrect (implausible) case presentation
links.effect: ChatGPT failed to identify an intentionally incorrect presentation.
links.quote: ChatGPT was less reliable with more complex pathologies and failed to identify an intentionally incorrect presentation.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's diagnostic accuracy and utility on nine clinical hand surgery vignettes graded by orthopedic surgeons without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
